title: Procreate Fashion Models Mockups Set 1
author: Everglo Travel Designs
description:
Hello, and welcome to Golden Glo Art!
Don’t enjoy using Photoshop layers? Canva mockups feel a little limited or tricky? Try Procreate — it’s easy, quick, and completely painless! This elegant 4 Fashion Dress Mockup Set allows you to showcase your seamless patterns and artwork with just a few taps. Whether you’re building a portfolio, selling patterns online, or creating beautiful previews for clients, these Procreate mockups make your designs look stunning with almost no effort.
Use them for:
• Pattern previews
• Fabric shops
• Portfolio presentations
• Branding and social media
• Client showcases
• Digital product displays
Your artwork instantly wraps onto the dress using the included mask—just add your design, set it to Clipping Mask, and adjust the blend mode. It’s quick, easy, and incredibly beautiful!
★ Please remember: This is a digital product. No physical item will be shipped.
________________________________________
WHAT’S INCLUDED
________________________________________
• 4 high-quality Procreate layered mockup files (.procreate)
• Each file includes a clean layer mask for easy design placement
• Instructions included in a PDF file
________________________________________
Software compatibility:
Procreate files are compatible with Procreate on iPad.
(Perfect for designers who work with seamless patterns, repeat prints, and surface design.)
________________________________________
Perfect For:
• Surface pattern designers
• Fabric designers
• Boutique digital creators
• Anyone needing beautiful dress mockups
FILES ARE NOT TO BE RESOLD, REDISTRIBUTED, OR OFFERED AS FREEBIES.
Happy Designing and thank you for your support! 💛
